minimum_requirement: Aggregate net PnL positive after fees; PF >= 1.10; no-trade beaten; passive BTC comparison reported; data coverage clean.
preferred_requirement: PF >= 1.20; positive breadth; acceptable max DD; no excessive concentration.
failure_condition: Aggregate negative, PF < 1.00, no-trade not beaten, missing passive BTC comparison, or data leakage risk.
decision_impact: Fail or park; no confirmation planning.

minimum_requirement: Report passive BTC PnL and active-minus-passive gap.
preferred_requirement: Active strategy beats passive BTC or has predeclared materially lower drawdown/exposure/tail risk.
failure_condition: Passive BTC dominates by a large margin and no lower-risk portfolio role is proven.
notes: Positive active PnL alone is insufficient.

minimum_requirement: Positive after-fee net PnL, PF >= 1.10, non-trivial trade count, average/median trade not dependent on one outlier.
preferred_requirement: PF >= 1.20 with stable market breadth and sensible drawdown.
failure_condition: PF < 1.00, low trade count, result dominated by one trade/market, or fees erase edge.
decision_impact: Fail or caution depending on severity.
notes: Expected value must be visible beyond raw PnL.

minimum_requirement: Positive market count and concentration reported; BTCUSDT/DOGEUSDT/DOTUSDT/UNIUSDT visible.
preferred_requirement: Positive breadth across markets; top-3 contribution not excessive; no single-market dependence.
failure_condition: Weak breadth, top-market concentration, or cherry-picked market support.
notes: C Donchian had 9 positive and 10 negative markets and 67.07% top-3 positive contribution.

applies_to: candidates marked promising after first pass
minimum_requirement: Clears continue gate, passive BTC gate, data-quality checks, and has predeclared confirmation plan.
preferred_requirement: Repeatable result on independent holdout/later-data with unchanged rules.
failure_condition: Requires tuning, market removal, or post-result reinterpretation to survive.
decision_impact: Only then can be a confirmation candidate; still not implementation-ready.

minimum_requirement: Independent confirmation passed; operational risks documented; explicit user approval requested.
preferred_requirement: Robust after fees/slippage, acceptable drawdown, clean data lineage, clear kill criteria.
failure_condition: Single tournament pass, benchmark underperformance, unresolved data issues, or missing approval.
notes: Dry-run is not automatic after research success.

minimum_requirement: Separate dry-run evidence, risk controls, deployment review, and explicit live approval.
preferred_requirement: Stable dry-run behavior plus production readiness review.
failure_condition: Research-only validation or dry-run not completed.
notes: Live candidate requires a separate approval chain.
